Prady Documentation Hub

v1.0.0 GA

Welcome to the official Prady documentation. Learn the basics, explore the handbook, browse the standard library and 28 native data structures, or configure the CLI.

Prady is a statically-typed programming language engineered for mission-critical architectural systems. It gives engineers the safety and speed of modern systems languages alongside the simplicity and ergonomics of TypeScript.

If you're new to Prady, start here to install the compiler and write your first program.
